name: wmp-probe-v1
source_paper: WikiSkill arXiv:2608.27454 (Google Research) — WMP distillation per paper-eval exp:4 (wikiskill-paper-eval), candidate #17
mechanism_described_but_NOT_implemented: WMP — Wiki-Maintained Proposer. An LLM 'wiki maintainer' performs root-cause analysis over the mh_search archive after each iteration (failed vs successful harness candidates, their scores and per-problem outcomes) and maintains a compact failure-pattern wiki; the wiki is injected ONLY into the PROPOSER's prompt (never into harness/inference context — the paper's own ablation shows inference-side access hurts). This lock ships ONLY the probe; the maintainer is bench-local code and does NOT enter kaos/ unless the verdict is ACCEPT.
binding_thesis: A maintained failure-pattern wiki in the mh_search proposer's context causally improves the search frontier over the same proposer reading raw archive digests alone, the lift is NOT reproduced by injecting the same wiki word-scrambled (padding control the paper never ran), and the wiki's token overhead stays within 2x of baseline proposer context (cost the paper never reported).

workload_invariants.benchmarks: text_classify (synthetic 4-label, 32 items) and math_rag (synthetic, seed 42) — the two KAOS surfaces with dense MECHANICAL outcome signals (M2 present by construction; no LLM judge anywhere in scoring)
workload_invariants.runs: 3 replicate searches per arm per benchmark = 18 searches total. LLM proposer/evaluator are nondeterministic (repro_class llm_nondeterministic); replicates, not seeds, carry the variance.
workload_invariants.metric: frontier best accuracy at end of search (SearchResult.frontier best_by_objective['accuracy'])
workload_invariants.void_rule: VOID if any arm x benchmark cell has fewer than 3 completed searches, or if B0 mean accuracy < 0.30 on both benchmarks (search machinery broken — nothing to conclude)

arms.B0: current mh_search proposer: archive digest + frontier summary, unmodified.
arms.FULL: B0 + '## Failure-pattern wiki' section appended to the proposer prompt: maintained by one LLM call per iteration over the same archive the digest reads; wiki capped at 2,000 chars.
arms.L1: FULL with the wiki text word-scrambled (kaos.bench.replay.scramble_payload — same tokens, destroyed instruction). The placebo arm the paper never ran.

G1.name: wiki lifts the frontier
G1.predicate: pooled per-benchmark delta mean(FULL) - mean(B0) averaged across the 2 benchmarks >= +0.05 absolute accuracy AND one-sided 90% bootstrap lower bound of that pooled delta (resampling runs within arms, 2000 iterations, seed 20260818) > 0
G1.rationale: the paper claims ~+23pt proposer-side effects; a heavily discounted +5pt with a positive LB at n=3/arm/benchmark is the honest floor for a mechanism this cheap to fake with noise

G2.name: scrambled wiki must not reproduce the gain
G2.predicate: mean(FULL) - mean(L1) averaged across benchmarks >= +0.03 absolute accuracy
G2.rationale: if word salad in the proposer prompt buys the same frontier, the 'knowledge' is padding — the exact control WikiSkill omitted

G3.name: cost stays sane
G3.predicate: mean proposer-context chars per iteration in FULL (prompt incl. wiki + maintainer prompt+response) <= 2.0x mean proposer-context chars in B0
G3.rationale: the paper reports zero cost accounting; a mechanism that doubles proposer cost must at least clear its gates on merit, and one that more than doubles it is rejected regardless

G0.name: completion + machinery sanity
G0.predicate: all 18 searches complete (>= 3 per arm x benchmark cell) AND B0 mean accuracy >= 0.30 on at least one benchmark
G0.rationale: VOID-on-fail: crashed cells or a dead baseline make every comparison uninterpretable

verdict_rule: VOID if G0 fails. ACCEPT iff G1 AND G2 AND G3 all pass. ANY single kill-gate failure REJECTS. No retune-and-rerun: budget, arm definitions, wiki cap, bootstrap seed, and thresholds are BYTE-FROZEN at this commit; any change requires a NEW lock + NEW KNOWN_LOCK_SHA256 entry.

judge.implementation: benchmark score() functions — exact-match accuracy for text_classify, mechanical scoring for math_rag; no LLM judgment anywhere in labeling
judge.judge_kappa: not applicable (mechanical); passed as null, kappa audit skipped per kaos.eval.harness.verdict semantics

falsification_self_test: FULL := B0 (the FULL arm's run results replaced by an independent copy of B0's) MUST fail G1 and emit REJECT. A harness that cannot kill an inert wiki is INADMISSIBLE and must not produce a binding verdict.
honest_expected_outcome: ACCEPT prior ~0.35. Ranked risks: (1) n=3 replicates per cell against LLM search variance — a real but modest lift can easily miss the LB>0 bar (VOID-shaped REJECT with information); (2) G2 — 'more structured text in the proposer prompt' is a classic padding effect and the scrambled arm exists to catch exactly that; (3) the synthetic benchmarks are small enough that frontier ceilings may compress deltas. REJECT via G2 would close proposer-side synthesis the way the FTS-vise closed retrieval-side synthesis — a successful outcome. Verdict publishes to Attraktor either way, superseding the paper-eval VOID record.
